item.title: Kamikura Hina no Himitsu ~Gohoubi wa Watashi no Karada♪~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Astronauts: Comet
  • 発売日: 2020-01-31
  • スコア: 7.17/10 (64 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 上倉雛のヒミツ ～ごほうびは私のカラダ♪～
  • 英語名: Kamikura Hina no Himitsu Gohoubi wa Watashi no Karada♪

あらすじ

Makoto is on the university swimming team, but he can’t seem to better his time. He discussed with his coach and the reliable club leader, and they determined that it wasn’t a physical or mental problem. However, they were unable to figure out the underlying cause.

item.title: Adebana Sacrament -Seinaru Miwaza to Akuryoutsuki no Shoujo-tachi-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Astronauts: Comet
  • 発売日: 2017-11-24
  • スコア: 6.4/10 (47 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 艶花サクラメント －性なる御技と悪霊憑きの少女たち－
  • 英語名: Adebana Sacrament -Seinaru Miwaza to Akuryoutsuki no Shoujo-tachi-

あらすじ

Evil spirits definitely exist in this world.

In addition, those unbeknown to the public who banish and control these spirits also exist.

These individuals are called “Exorcists” by those aware of their existence.

What society usually refers to when referring to “Exorcists” are the clergy responsible for mundane exorcisms, but in reality there exist evil spirits who can physically harm humans as well as clergy who fight these spirits.

item.title: Aristear Remain
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Astronauts: Comet
  • 発売日: 2016-07-29
  • スコア: 7.4799999999999995/10 (81 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アリスティア・リメイン
  • 英語名: Aristear Remain

あらすじ

In a different world that’s similar to modern-day Japan, ‘magic’ exists alongside science and technology. It may seem like a peaceful world, but there are many irregular happenings which commonly occur out of sight. They are the work of the ‘handymen’, individuals who work for the ‘Underground Society’, doing any job so long as it doesn’t break the law.

item.description:

  • 英語名: Tou no Shita no Exercitus

别名

  • Under the tower exercitus

あらすじ

A long, long time ago, a certain civilization lived in prosperity with its superior technology until it destroyed itself due to over-development. The world was destroyed in this “accident”, but it gradually recovered after a long time. However, it was limited only to the areas surrounding the Tower of Velvalem, built by the “family of the dawn”.

item.title: Tsukiyo no Mura
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Astronauts: Comet
  • 発売日: 2014-11-28
  • スコア: 6.37/10 (101 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 憑夜ノ村
  • 英語名: Tsukiyo no Mura

あらすじ

A young magazine journalist returned to the village where he spent his childhood, accompanied by his female assistant, for a story.

What awaited him was the same oppressive, stifling atmosphere he remembered from his youth—and a childhood friend who had grown into a stunningly beautiful young woman.

This woman, who now used her body to dominate the men of the village, sought to draw the two of them into the village’s insular, suffocating circle.

item.title: Tsukumo Onna Aoe
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Astronauts: Comet
  • 発売日: 2014-10-24
  • スコア: 6.63/10 (46 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 付喪女・あおゑ
  • 英語名: Tsukumo Onna Aoe

あらすじ

Beings like yokai, demons, and ghosts aren’t just myths—they’re real. Those who prey on humans are called “Ayakashi,” and it’s the job of exorcists to protect people from their threat.

The protagonist, Moritsugu, is one such exorcist. Still only half-fledged, he works alongside his childhood friend and senior exorcist, Aifumi.

One day, Ayakashi surge in number across Suoku City. Aifumi asks Moritsugu to investigate. Fired up to prove himself and be recognized as a full-fledged exorcist, he’s given something by Aifumi: a spirit blade—a weapon for cutting down Ayakashi, inhabited by a Tsukumogami. “Its name is Aoe,” she says. “From today, it’s your partner.”
